```{r load packages and data objects}

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)

amfar = readRDS("/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/10x/5.merged_annotation_final_object_v1/sobj_final_v1.rds")


sobjs_all = amfar

sobjs_all = subset(sobjs_all, cells = Cells(sobjs_all)[ 
    (sobjs_all$fine_annotation != "NK_platelet") & 
    (sobjs_all$tp != "postR2") & 
    !(sobjs_all$pid == "35933" & sobjs_all$tp == "postR1") & 
    !(sobjs_all$pid == "60610" & sobjs_all$tp == "UD2") & 
    !(sobjs_all$pid == "60610" & sobjs_all$tp == "UD1") ])


match_UDs_to_otherTPs <- function(tp) {
  tp = as.character(tp)
  tp = case_when(
    grepl("UD1", tp) ~ gsub("UD1", "preR", tp),
    grepl("UD2", tp) ~ gsub("UD2", "postR1", tp),
    TRUE ~ tp
    )
  return(tp)
}
tp_order = c("preATI", "vaccinal", "preR", "postR1", "postR2")
plot_style = read.csv("/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/sample_metadata/plot_style.csv")

amfar = sobjs_all
amfar$pid_tp = match_UDs_to_otherTPs(amfar$pid_tp)
amfar$tp = match_UDs_to_otherTPs(amfar$tp)


```


### CD8 T cell clonotype dynamics
```{r cd8 clonotype analysis - final }
#sobj_cd8 = subset(amfar, subset = broad_annotation_new == "manualSubset_CD8")
sobj_nncd8 = subset(amfar, subset = fine_annotation %in% setdiff(unique(amfar$fine_annotation[ amfar$broad_annotation_new == "manualSubset_CD8"]), c("CD8_naive","MAIT","CD8_NKT")) )

downsample = function(tbl, size = 1000, seed=1234, pid_tp) {
    clonotype_flat = c()
    for(i in 1:nrow(tbl)) {
        clonotype_flat = c(clonotype_flat, rep(as.character(tbl$clonotype[i]), tbl$Freq[i]) )    
    }
    set.seed(seed)
    clonotype_flat = sample(clonotype_flat, size = size)
    return(as.data.frame(table(clonotype_flat)) %>% setNames(c("clonotype","Freq")) %>% mutate(pid_tp = pid_tp))
}


calc_bootstrap_pval = function(freq_tmp_tp1, freq_tmp_tp2, seeds, padj_cutoff = 0.1, l2fc_cutoff = 1) {
  tp1_total = sum(freq_tmp_tp1$Freq)
  tp2_total = sum(freq_tmp_tp2$Freq)
  if(tp1_total == 0 | tp2_total == 0)
      next
  all_clonotypes = unique(c(as.vector(freq_tmp_tp1$clonotype), as.vector(freq_tmp_tp2$clonotype)))
  contract_count = rep(0, length(all_clonotypes)) %>% setNames(all_clonotypes)
  expand_count = rep(0, length(all_clonotypes)) %>% setNames(all_clonotypes)
  for(seed in seeds) {
    if(downsample_larger) {
      if(tp1_total > tp2_total) {
        freq_tp1 = downsample(
          freq_tmp_tp1, tp2_total, 
          seed=seed, pid_tp = freq_tmp_tp1$pid_tp[1])
        freq_tp2 = freq_tmp_tp2
      } else if(tp1_total < tp2_total) {
        freq_tp2 = downsample(
          freq_tmp_tp2, tp1_total, 
          seed=seed, pid_tp = freq_tmp_tp2$pid_tp[1])
        freq_tp1 = freq_tmp_tp1
      } else {
        freq_tp1 = freq_tmp_tp1
        freq_tp2 = freq_tmp_tp2
      }
    }
    freq_tmp = full_join(
      freq_tp1[,c("Freq","clonotype")] %>% rename(Freq_tp1 = Freq), 
      freq_tp2[,c("Freq","clonotype")] %>% rename(Freq_tp2 = Freq), 
      by="clonotype")
    freq_tmp[ is.na(freq_tmp) ] = 0
    
    freq_tmp = freq_tmp %>% mutate(
      pct_tp1 = (Freq_tp1+1)/sum(Freq_tp1+1)*100,
      pct_tp2 = (Freq_tp2+1)/sum(Freq_tp2+1)*100
      )
  
    freq_tmp$pval = NA
    freq_tmp$odds_ratio = NA
    for(cln in unique(as.vector(freq_tmp$clonotype))) {
      idx = freq_tmp$clonotype == cln
      f = freq_tmp[idx,]
      ft = fisher.test( 
        matrix(
          c(f$Freq_tp1, 
            sum(freq_tmp$Freq_tp1)-f$Freq_tp1, 
            f$Freq_tp2, 
            sum(freq_tmp$Freq_tp2)-f$Freq_tp2), 
          nrow=2) )
      freq_tmp$pval[idx] = ft$p.value
      freq_tmp$odds_ratio[idx] = ft$estimate
    }
    freq_tmp$l2fc = log2( freq_tmp$pct_tp2 / freq_tmp$pct_tp1 )
    freq_tmp = arrange(freq_tmp, pval)
    freq_tmp$padj = p.adjust(freq_tmp$pval, method="BH")
    freq_tmp$dir = ifelse(
      freq_tmp$padj < padj_cutoff & freq_tmp$l2fc >= l2fc_cutoff, 
      "expanded", 
      ifelse( 
        freq_tmp$padj < padj_cutoff & freq_tmp$l2fc <= -1*l2fc_cutoff, 
        "contracted", 
        "ns"
        )  
      )
    signif_expand = as.vector(freq_tmp$clonotype[ freq_tmp$dir == "expanded"])
    signif_contract = as.vector(freq_tmp$clonotype[ freq_tmp$dir == "contracted"])
    if(length(signif_expand) > 0) {
      expand_count[signif_expand] = expand_count[signif_expand] + 1
    }
    if(length(signif_contract) > 0) {
      contract_count[signif_contract] = contract_count[signif_contract] + 1
    }
  }
  return(list(last_freq_tmp=freq_tmp, contract_count=contract_count, expand_count=expand_count))
}


freq = as.data.frame(table(sobj_nncd8@meta.data[ , c("pid_tp","tcr_clonotype_aa") ] %>% na.omit())) %>% filter(Freq > 0) %>% rename("clonotype"="tcr_clonotype_aa")
freq$pid = str_extract(freq$pid_tp, "^\\d+")
freq$tp = factor(str_extract(freq$pid_tp, "[^_]+$"), levels=tp_order)

downsample_larger = TRUE
niter = 100
set.seed(1234)
seeds = sample(1:niter, replace=F)

tp1 = "preATI"
tp2 = "preR"
pval_cutoff = 0.01
padj_cutoff = 0.1
l2fc_cutoff = 1
plotlist = list()
signif_change = data.frame()
all_res = data.frame()
for( p in sort(unique(freq$pid)) ) {
  print(p)
  freq_tmp_tp1 = freq[ freq$pid == p & freq$tp %in% c(tp1), ]
  freq_tmp_tp2 = freq[ freq$pid == p & freq$tp %in% c(tp2), ]
  if(nrow(freq_tmp_tp1) == 0 | nrow(freq_tmp_tp2) == 0) {
    next
  }
  if(TRUE) { # Calculate log2FC using the full dataset
    freq_tmp = full_join(
      freq_tmp_tp1[,c("Freq","clonotype")] %>% rename(Freq_tp1 = Freq),
      freq_tmp_tp2[,c("Freq","clonotype")] %>% rename(Freq_tp2 = Freq), 
      by="clonotype")
    freq_tmp[ is.na(freq_tmp) ] = 0
    
    freq_tmp = freq_tmp %>% mutate(
      pct_tp1 = (Freq_tp1+1)/sum(Freq_tp1+1)*100, 
      pct_tp2 = (Freq_tp2+1)/sum(Freq_tp2+1)*100, 
      )

    freq_tmp$pval = NA
    freq_tmp$odds_ratio = NA
    for(cln in unique(freq_tmp$clonotype)) {
        idx = freq_tmp$clonotype == cln
        f = freq_tmp[idx,]
        ft = fisher.test( matrix(c(f$Freq_tp1, sum(freq_tmp$Freq_tp1)-f$Freq_tp1, f$Freq_tp2, sum(freq_tmp$Freq_tp2)-f$Freq_tp2), nrow=2) )
        freq_tmp$pval[idx] = ft$p.value
        freq_tmp$odds_ratio[idx] = ft$estimate
    }
    freq_tmp$l2fc = log2( freq_tmp$pct_tp2 / freq_tmp$pct_tp1 )
    freq_tmp = arrange(freq_tmp, pval)
    freq_tmp$padj = p.adjust(freq_tmp$pval, method="BH")
    freq_tmp$dir = ifelse(
      freq_tmp$padj < padj_cutoff & freq_tmp$l2fc >= l2fc_cutoff, 
      "expanded", 
      ifelse( 
        freq_tmp$padj < padj_cutoff & freq_tmp$l2fc <= -1*l2fc_cutoff, 
        "contracted", 
        "ns"
        )  
      )
  }
  bootstrap_signif = calc_bootstrap_pval(freq_tmp_tp1, freq_tmp_tp2, seeds = seeds, padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoff)
  bts_signif_clonotypes = ifelse(bootstrap_signif$contract_count > niter/2, "contracted", ifelse( bootstrap_signif$expand_count > niter/2, "expanded", "ns" ))
  #freq_tmp = bootstrap_signif$last_freq_tmp
  freq_tmp$bootstrap_dir = bts_signif_clonotypes[ as.vector(freq_tmp$clonotype) ]
  all_res = rbind(all_res, freq_tmp %>% mutate(p=p))
  signif_change = rbind(signif_change, freq_tmp[ freq_tmp$bootstrap_dir != "ns", ] %>% mutate(p=p) )
  plotlist[[p]] = ggplot(freq_tmp, aes(log10(pct_tp1), log10(pct_tp2), color=bootstrap_dir, label=clonotype)) + 
      geom_point(aes(alpha=bootstrap_dir), size=3) + theme_classic() + 
      scale_color_manual(values=c("contracted"="blue", "expanded"="red", "ns"="grey80")) + 
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) + 
      labs(title=p, x=paste0("log10(",tp1,")"), y=paste0("log10(",tp2,")")) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values=c("contracted"=1, "expanded"=1, "ns"=0.2)) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = freq_tmp %>% dplyr::filter(bootstrap_dir != "ns"))
}

pdf(paste0("/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/10x/5.merged_annotation_final_object_v1/tcr_analysis/nncd8_", tp1, "_vs_", tp2, ".pdf"), width=10, height=6)
ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = plotlist)
dev.off()



# Combining all PID plots into one.
df = data.frame()
for(p in names(plotlist)){
    df = rbind(df, plotlist[[p]]$data %>% mutate(pid = p) )
}
df = df %>% mutate(label = paste0(pid, ":", clonotype))
plot = ggplot(df, aes(log10(pct_tp1), log10(pct_tp2), color=bootstrap_dir, label=label)) + 
    geom_point(aes(alpha=bootstrap_dir), size=3) + theme_classic() + 
    scale_color_manual(values=c("contracted"="blue", "expanded"="red", "ns"="grey80")) + 
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) + 
    labs(title="All pids combined", x=paste0("log10(",tp1,")"), y=paste0("log10(", ifelse(tp2 == "vaccinal", "bNAb", tp2) ,")")) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values=c("contracted"=1, "expanded"=1, "ns"=0.2)) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = df %>% dplyr::filter(bootstrap_dir != "ns"))

pdf(paste0("/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/10x/5.merged_annotation_final_object_v1/tcr_analysis/nncd8_", tp1, "_vs_", tp2, "_pidsCombined_v2.pdf"), width=7, height=6)
plot
dev.off()
```

### Find median and range of number of non-naive Ts with valid TCR per sample 
```{r}

df = rbind(
  data.frame(pid_tp = sobj_nncd8$pid_tp, tcr = sobj_nncd8$tcr_clonotype_aa),
  data.frame(pid_tp = sobj_nncd4$pid_tp, tcr = sobj_nncd4$tcr_clonotype_aa)
)

median(table(df$pid_tp[ ! is.na(df$tcr) ]))
range(table(df$pid_tp[ ! is.na(df$tcr) ]))


```
